The '''''Hot Streak''''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] that was owned by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Kelna Toodo]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|Jokot}}</ref> Toodo was tasked by his employer, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]]-owner [[Beeda]], with eliminating some individuals who had meddled with the Hutt's affairs. To that end, Toodo traveled to the port town [[Akmalla]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and deceived the individuals into gaining possession of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Radiant Splendor]]''. Toodo's targets then departed aboard their new [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and the Duros pursued them in the ''Hot Streak'', planning to remotely deactivate the cage of a [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panther]] that was being carried aboard the ''Splendor'', so that it could [[Death/Legends|kill]] the individuals.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />
